investment_theses.thesis: Nvidia's 14% plunge and longest losing streak since 2008 signals capitulation in AI capex cycle; oversold semiconductor exposure via shorts on SMH or long VIX calls becomes asymmetric risk-reward over 30-60 days.
supporting_signals: CNBC: NVDA plunges 14%, wrapped longest weekly losing streak since 2008 financial crisis
CNBC: Options traders place big bets semiconductor stocks have further to fall
Nvidia now ranks 4th by market cap (dropped from most valuable company in world)
investment_theses.counter_view: AI demand remains genuine; NVDA multiple compression justified by slowing growth; Blackwell/Rubin super-cycle not yet baked in; further downside possible if earnings miss.
investment_theses.expression: Long SMH (Semiconductor ETF) calls or short SMH puts; or long IVV (small basket of NVDA, AMD, MU) with 2-3 month call spreads
